propositions: rebar doctor lacked diagnostic surface for held or orphaned locks, forcing operators to manually inspect lock directories with shell commands

rebar doctor must report four lock legs (tickets-write fcntl, tickets-write mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent/unknown state and holder metadata (v2 stamp, liveness, age) without mutating lock state
lock holder liveness detection must be same-host-only, reporting unprobeable status for foreign hosts rather than guessing at pids
stale lock determination must use only the shared lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale function; no independent staleness heuristics are permitted in the new module
only stale lock legs produce findings and force exit code 1; held locks with live holders are info-level and keep exit code 0
rebar doctor --output json must include locks and lock_findings keys validated against the updated doctor.schema.json
